caption: How to make an $8k/month youtube channel with Claude #ai #tech
author: Rui Fu
transcript: Most people don't realize that you can build a faceless YouTube channel that makes 8k a month with clout in 11 labs. One person ran this content system for only 4 months and just hit 8k a month and he only spends 3 hours a week on it. A lot of people make this mistake when starting out. Don't pick a niche that you like, pick one that pays. A faceless finance channel with 500,000 views a month at $20 RPM nets you about 10k a month from just adsense alone. Whereas an entertainment channel only gets $3-8 per 1,000 views. This is the exact prompt that you should put into clout in order to get a data-driven recommendation for which niche to choose instead of choosing random ones. It's based on content repeatability, audience size, and monetization options beyond adsense. Set up the content script system. You can automate script writing with clout but the script system has to be built correctly because clout can give a lot of bad scripts. This is the prompt that I use in order to generate the script system for every single video and you can find it in my guide. It tells clout to write a hook that creates a pattern to interrupt in the first 30 seconds, use open loops to tease the payoff early, write in spoken English and not essay English, include pause markers and visual tags for every scene, and ends with a soft CTA. This replaces a $200 script writer and also gives you thumbnail options and title options to use which you can put in NanoBananaPro. This is the exact pipeline that I use. Claude writes the scripts, 11 laps for the sound and voiceover, CapCut and CamelCam sums the video with stock footage from Pixels. Claude then writes the title, description, tags, and chapter markers with this prompt. Use TubeBuddy or VidCue for keyword check. Post 1-2 videos for the first week and then 3-4 videos after warping up the count. By month 4, you should be adding in affiliates and sponsorships. One faceless channel has 600,000 views a month at $18 RPM. Post $10,800 a month from just adsense alone. I made a step-by-step guide with the exact prompts in order to build this out. Just comment video and I'll send it to you. Follow for more news and advice on how to make money with tech and AI.
title: Build $8k/Month Faceless YouTube Channel with AI
one_liner: Use Claude and ElevenLabs to automate a faceless YouTube channel earning $8k/month in 4 months.
key_points: Pick high-RPM niches like finance ($20 RPM) over entertainment ($3-8 RPM) for maximum AdSense revenue
Use Claude to generate niche recommendations, video scripts with hooks/open loops, and SEO metadata — replacing a $200 script writer
Full automation pipeline: Claude for scripts, ElevenLabs for voiceover, CapCut for editing, stock footage from Pexels
Post 1-2 videos/week at launch, scale to 3-4, then add affiliates and sponsorships by month 4
